structured_output.summary: POST /links now keeps calling randomSlug() while store.has(slug) is true, so an existing link is never overwritten. The change is a single line in src/app.js. New test/slug-collision.test.js forces collisions with 'aaa','aaa','bbb'. It checks the second POST returns 201 with slug 'bbb' and shortUrl '/bbb'. It checks /aaa and /stats/aaa still show the original link, and /stats/bbb shows the new one. It also checks that randomSlug is called once without a collision and not at all for an invalid URL (400). npm test passes (8/8).
